00 Average_Days_Outstanding_by_PO.description: Power BI measure 00 Average_Days_Outstanding_by_PO on fact_project_billing_current_v.
00 Average_Days_Outstanding_by_PO.expression:
AVERAGEX(
    'fact_project_billing_current_v',
    VAR INVDateFilter = 
        CALCULATE(
            MAX('fact_project_billing_current_v'[invoice_date]), 
            'fact_project_billing_current_v'[gross_amount] > 0,
            NOT(ISBLANK(fact_project_billing_current_v[paid_date])),
            'fact_project_billing_current_v'[export_date] = MAX('fact_project_billing_current_v'[export_date])
        )
    
    VAR LatestPaidDate = 
        CALCULATE(
            MAX('fact_project_billing_current_v'[paid_date]),
            NOT(ISBLANK(fact_project_billing_current_v[paid_date])),
            'fact_project_billing_current_v'[gross_amount] > 0
        )

    VAR IsPaid = NOT(ISBLANK(LatestPaidDate))

    VAR DateDiff = 
        IF(
            IsPaid,
            DATEDIFF(INVDateFilter, LatestPaidDate, DAY),
            DATEDIFF(INVDateFilter, TODAY(), DAY)
        )

    RETURN DateDiff
)

Arrow_Date.expression:
VAR DateCount =
    CALCULATE (
        DISTINCTCOUNT ( 'Trending Data'[Month] ),
        ALL ( 'Trending Data'[Month] )
    )

VAR LatestDate =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Trending Data'[Month] ),
        ALL ( 'Trending Data'[Month] )
    )

VAR SecondLatestDate =
    MAXX (
        TOPN (
            1,
            FILTER (
                ALL ( 'Trending Data'[Month] ),
                'Trending Data'[Month] < LatestDate
            ),
            'Trending Data'[Month], DESC
        ),
        'Trending Data'[Month]
    )

RETURN
    IF (
        DateCount = 1,
        LatestDate,
        IF (
            LatestDate >= TODAY () - 7,
            SecondLatestDate,
            LatestDate
        )
    )

FIN_ARDays_Arrow.expression:
VAR IsActive = [AGED RECEIVABLES DAYS Value]

VAR SelectedArrowDate =
    [Arrow_Date]
    
VAR CurrentAvg =
    ROUND(AVERAGE ( 'Project Grades'[Average_Days_Outstanding_by_PO]),2)

VAR TrendingAvg =
    CALCULATE (
        ROUND(AVERAGE ( 'Trending Data'[Average_Days_Outstanding_by_PO] ),2),
        'Trending Data'[Month] = SelectedArrowDate
    )

RETURN
    IF(
        IsActive <> 1,
        BLANK(),
        SWITCH(
            TRUE(),
            CurrentAvg > TrendingAvg, UNICHAR ( 9650 ),
            CurrentAvg = TrendingAvg, "-",
            CurrentAvg < TrendingAvg, UNICHAR ( 9660 )
        )
    )
